notes: MiniMax M3 emits an mm:think pair inline in content; without a server-side split the reasoning leaks into content, so the reasoning adapter strips the pair like every other pair in the reasoning-tag constants. MiniMax M2 often omits the opening think tag and emits only the close: the adapter treats everything before a leading think or mm:think close tag as reasoning only when the caller opts in with implicit_open (default false, so a stray close tag still fails closed).
